title: event message: data
description: A chat line in a room, channel or thread. Camfrog: s2c 0x06 with a non-empty sender.

message_id.description: Platform message id, or a connector-generated one when the platform has none (Camfrog).

text.description: Plain-text rendering of the whole message. Always present so simple modules never parse elements.

content.description: Structured elements, when the platform gives more than text (mentions, emoji, media).

self.description: Sent by the connector's own account (echo of the bot's own line). Matchers ignore these by default.

mentions_self.description: The message addresses the bot (mention, reply to the bot, or platform-specific addressing).

relay_ref.description: (1.1) On a self line: id of the relay action (or job) this echo answers. Lets a bridge hub mark the delivery echoed instead of ingesting it.

webhook_id.description: (1.1) Sent through this platform webhook (Discord); hubs drop lines from their own webhooks.

remote_reply_to.description: (1.1) The platform's reply target when it is not a message_id this session reported (an older message); the hub resolves it through its id map.
